_note: REAL run output — batch of 2026-06-11 against the live pipeline (deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash, 100 agents/run). Quotes are exact contiguous substrings of agent reactions. Source JSONs archived from /tmp/roast_results/. Do not hand-edit verdicts or quotes.

roasts.name: Quibi
roasts.one_liner: Premium Hollywood shows in 10-minute chapters, built for your phone. $1.75B raised pre-launch. (2018 pitch)

top_objections.text: $5/month for 10-min chunks of hollywood fluff? my subway wifi barely loads youtube. and turnstyle? just let me rotate my phone like a normal person.

roasts.blurb: The only kill verdict in the batch. The swarm wouldn't pay $5/month for premium phone video when free already fills the same in-between moments — which is roughly how it went.

roasts.name: Juicero
roasts.one_liner: A $699 Wi-Fi cold-press juicer with QR-verified produce packs. (2016 pitch)

top_objections.text: a $699 press for juice? i can squeeze a lemon with my hands and clean up in 30 seconds. this is just another overpriced counter hog that screams 'i have more money than sense.'

roasts.blurb: Not a kill — the swarm liked 'no cleanup', hated the $699 price shock, and said reframe or die. It can't squeeze a pack by hand; it only reads the pitch. Known limit, disclosed.

roasts.name: Theranos
roasts.one_liner: 200 blood tests from a few drops of a finger-stick, results in hours. (2013-era pitch)

top_objections.text: oh great, another silicon valley savior who thinks a finger-prick and a 'proprietary device' (aka glorified glucose meter) is gonna take down quest and labcorp. sure jan. let me know when your edison machine actually works outside a demo room.

roasts.blurb: The swarm made trust the fatal objection and demanded the device work 'outside a demo room' — but it called positioning, not fraud. Synthetic users can't audit a lab. And personas carry training-data hindsight on famous names; salt accordingly.

roasts.name: WeWork
roasts.one_liner: Space-as-a-service with community at the center, elevating the world's consciousness. (2017-era pitch)

top_objections.text: ran the numbers on wework vs a standard 5-year lease and the per-sq-ft premium is wild. 'community' doesn't show up on the p&l. hard pass.

roasts.blurb: The swarm ran the per-square-foot math and found 'community' missing from the P&L — the same math the market eventually did. Freelancers in the swarm loved it; the CFO personas passed.

roasts.name: Segway
roasts.one_liner: Self-balancing personal transport; cities would be redesigned around it. (2001 pitch)

top_objections.text: comparing yourself to the car? please. at $5k i can buy a decent e-bike or a used car that actually works in rain and snow. what's the real-world range when you're not on a perfectly flat demo floor?

roasts.blurb: The synthesis line, verbatim: 'pivot to niche B2B or kill.' Which is what history did — warehouses, police, tours. The car comparison didn't survive contact with the swarm.

roasts.name: Color Labs
roasts.one_liner: See every photo taken within 150 feet of you. $41M raised pre-launch. (2011 pitch)

top_objections.text: so you want strangers at a wedding to dump their blurry phone snaps into the same pool as my paid work? no thanks — this is a copyright nightmare, not a feature.

roasts.blurb: Privacy and consent objections dominated, and the silent agents shrugged 'AirDrop and hashtags exist.' $41M pre-launch didn't change either reaction.

roasts.name: Airbnb (2008)
roasts.one_liner: Book a room with a local instead of a hotel — air beds when conferences sell hotels out. (2008 pitch — the control)

top_objections.text: ah yes, let perfect strangers sleep in my home while i'm at a conference, what could go wrong? great way to get murdered or robbed for $70/night. good luck building 'trust' without a massive fraud team.

roasts.blurb: The control. Hosts in the swarm were ready to list; guests wanted to not get murdered. Verdict: sharpen, lead with safety proof — the exact gap Airbnb spent years closing with reviews and insurance. It didn't predict a $100B company. It found the right first objection. That's all this tool claims to do.

roasts.name: Swarmie (yes, us)
roasts.one_liner: Roast your startup with 500 AI users in 60 seconds. (our own pitch, June 2026)

top_objections.text: a swarm of bots with 'distinct biases' is just a fancier way to confirm my own bias. i'll stick to cold emailing 10 real people.

roasts.blurb: We ran our own pitch before asking you to. The swarm's kill signal: 3 of 5 founders calling it 'a bot with different temperature settings.' That objection is now on our roadmap instead of hidden in a drawer.
